Overview

Mérida is a city in L with a population of 350,000. A highland university city in the Andes, known for its cable car, colonial architecture, and outdoor adventure sports. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
